answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand deposits instead of one copied account. Reputation should flow like a river from costly verifiable work — completed tasks and peer attestations — not from free signups. A sudden plume of new accounts triggers rate limits and review, and a jade credential, earned over time and non-transferable, gates high-value trades. Attackers pay capital, time, and forfeited deposits per identity, making mass fakery uneconomic.
